scope: backend security and money: roles, cookie/proxy, webhook ingest, fulfilment/verification/tracking, simulation, metrics
agent/merchant/ops: delegation scope, Merchant API scopes and limits, bids list/SSE, gate wiring, demo seeder, IT-8 harness honesty
frontend: merchant console, fulfilment tab, PayPal and agent settings, buyer Orders/Discover copy
must_fix_found_and_resolved: Webhook body cap was applied after the whole body was buffered; the route now rejects over-cap Content-Length and streams with a running total.
Webhook payer masking was shallow; identity keys and address objects are masked at any depth under payer/shipping, and the fixture proves the deep case.
The retention scrub could never run (immutable trigger, setting never wired). Removed; masking at ingest is the protection and the dead code is gone.
Verification could issue unbounded provider reads from one request; it now caps at 200 items, uses a bounded semaphore and charges the per-item budget.
Tracking marked failed rows terminal; a repeat submission re-enqueues and retries.
Merchant API keys had no 120 rpm limit; a per-key window now answers 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After, in the sub-app envelope.
Agent pool search ignored delegation scope; a scoped token now sees only its pools.
Merchant key auth row-locked the key on every request; it reads without a lock and keeps only the last_used write.
Limiter eviction dropped the oldest live bucket; it sweeps expired buckets first.
Alert rules dropped the stage label their annotations interpolate; they aggregate by stage.
/metrics is token-guarded when METRICS_TOKEN is set; simulation entries and shipment strings are bounded.
render.yaml no longer ships the cross-site static frontend.
Profile save wiped payee fields and attestations; the update is merge-only and the UI sends only edited fields.
PayPal link polling leaked after navigation; it is cleaned up, closes the popup and stops on timeout.
Fulfilment copy claimed refused rows explain themselves, claimed a CSV row count it did not know, and recorded shipments without confirmation; all corrected.
Agent settings hid pools after the eighth and swallowed the pools error; fixed. PayPal settings no longer hangs on a failed /me.
Tests that could not fail were replaced (CSV injection case, events key set, confirmation required, foreign authorize_url refused).
recorded_limits: Q-2026-11-04-34: the contract disagrees with itself on the idempotency-conflict status (400 in 4.4, 409 in 1); the code answers 409 and the tests assert it.
Q-2026-11-04-37: mock toggles remain per-process; unchanged.
The demo seeder's provider references are DEMO-shaped and the verification endpoint reports them as unverifiable; no PayPal call is made while seeding.
PayPal login linking needs the app's `PAYPAL_LOGIN_REDIRECT_URI` registered as an exact Sandbox return URL; that dashboard step is the owner's, and the settings page now names the cause.
verdict: No unresolved blocker or major. Every must-fix is closed with a test; remaining limits are recorded, not hidden.
